title: Evidence Reference
rationale: Retain derivation as one related provenance pattern, not as a definition of evidential use. Evidence may be used without deriving a new entity or endorsing a claim; a citation does not establish independent corroboration.
context_interpretation: The reference keeps documentary identity and ordinary RX-021 linkage. Its local-edge difference is the added GE-001 specialization from EvidenceReferenceRole, not an altered direct association. RE-001/RE-002 and C-26 separately describe grounded use and distinct participants. R-68 is read with C-12 and its no-proof rationale, preserving support/challenge/context distinctions.

title: Observation Result
rationale: Retain SOSA Result as related output context. SOSA also covers actuation and sampling results, while this Riskium concept selects observation information qualified by subject, method, time and available units; no class equivalence or imported restriction is asserted.
context_interpretation: RX-022 relates an ObservationActivity to its informational result; RX-023 identifies the indicator and RX-024 the continuing RiskCase. RK2-026 can retain context and RK2-017 connects revisions. The result is neither its activity nor a risk occurrence; a numeric value alone is insufficient for cross-context comparison.

title: Indicator
rationale: Retain DQV Metric and SOSA ObservableProperty as bounded pattern comparisons. DQV concerns dataset quality; SOSA describes an observable feature quality. Riskium Indicator is an information specification, distinct from the property and its measured value.
context_interpretation: RX-023 links reported results to their indicator specification; RX-025 can anchor a threshold. Specification versions and interpretation remain documentary. Neither external property classes nor DQV domain constraints are automatically imported into Riskium.

title: Threshold
rationale: Clarify the former scoped-absence label as a contrast in intended role: a DQV measuring standard does not itself specify a comparator-qualified decision boundary. No global absence, class disjointness or exact threshold equivalence is asserted.
context_interpretation: RX-025 and RK2-020 each permit an indicator or scale anchor. C-08 requires at least one supported anchor, with compatible interpretation if both exist; it does not require both. Qualitative boundaries retain scale semantics rather than invented numerical units. RX-027 records selected signal comparison.

title: Signal
rationale: Retain the relationship to observation results without equating every signal with a SOSA Result or an actual risk event. A signal is information selected as potentially relevant to review; its significance requires context.
context_interpretation: RX-026 requires supporting observation results in the managed signal profile; RX-027 can identify thresholds and RX-028 can prompt case review. Revised RiskCase meaning was reviewed. Source incomplete material is retained without fabricating observations; neither an alert nor a crossed threshold automatically proves a risk occurrence or cause.
